self_introduction.title: Software Engineer · Backend & Agentic AI
self_introduction.description:
I am Cyril Deschamps, a software engineering student at Polytech Montpellier, specialised in backend development and agentic AI. I interned at Ledger in the blockchain & BigData industry, where I optimised a JsonRPC streaming proxy (×16 user capacity, −40% memory) and contributed to structured knowledge management with an agentic approach. I build AI-powered tools using LangChain and work across the full stack with Scala, TypeScript, and React.
Available for a permanent position from October 2026.
